profile.name: Hazmi Badrunsham
profile.tagline: I build software, solve problems, and occasionally make things just because I want to see if I can.

paragraphs: Nothing much actually, just tryna land my first job.

points: Just continued from my internship, now working part-time.
Resolved application issues across web and mobile modules.
Created and maintained business reports using SQL and REPX.
Investigated data issues and performed basic root-cause analysis.
Participated in low-code development activities, including configuring workflows and supporting enhancements to meet operational requirements
Participated in API integration testing, Git-based workflows, and documentation.
